Guide to the Chinese Land Records, 1584-1978
doc_kind: Guide to the Chinese Land Records, 1584-1978
description_long: These Chinese Land Records are important and valuable primary documentation that reflect the land ownership in different historical periods, land tenure changes and land management system of China. As historical records they are indispensable for research and studies of Chinese politics, economy, social life, etc. Digital reproductions of the collection are available online. 这些珍贵的原始文献不仅提供了中国不同历史时期的土地所有，产权转让，土地管理系统的历史信息，也是研究中国政治史，经济史，社会生活史不可或缺的珍贵史料。检索指南包含了数字化副本​。
